name: vj5xv5-session-rules
goal: Record incident rules once in the signed Tracker journal, then verify that later Claude and Codex launches and Hub read the updated rules without restarting Tracker.

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Native launch guidance is compiled into trackerHostBrief and only changes with a release. Credential hunting, orphan tabs, oversized log reads and local model load exposed the lack of a replicated runtime rule source.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Extend the installed CLI/native journal and launcher coverage from static brief strings to a live incident append, replicated reads and fresh launch instructions. Extend private Hub overview coverage for recent entries.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: 0bc7b059c5: focused Vitest failed (2/2). CLI returned no JSON for rule list since the command is absent; native brief had no Session rules section.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Use an indexed v1 field on a signed journal operation, atomically append its visible incident note, and read the local projection at each launch. Publish recent entries through the owner-only Hub overview.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Rule CLI writes a v1 journal entry plus incident note, each native brief reads current local rules, and Hub owner overview publishes and renders the latest five.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Frozen cases e1a3e09092 failed; exact fix 84a4972bb0 passed the unchanged three-case command with the same environment/profile. Broader CLI, projection and brief suite passed 12/12.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: harbor-mbp-2 exact 54cd1566a9: removing only the rule lookup in an isolated checkout failed the managed foreground brief assertion; restoring the lookup and rerunning the identical case passed. Temporary fixture removed.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
